known_limitations: Bundle is ad-hoc signed only: locally built, NOT notarized, not Gatekeeper-ready for other machines; first open elsewhere needs right-click -> Open or System Settings -> Privacy & Security.

The data engine is imported at runtime from the live integration worktree, so the .app requires the repo checkout to exist at the resolved location (same location as the data itself); a future engine API change in the worktree would surface as DATA ERROR with the reason in the status block and app.log, not as fabricated numbers.

Per-fill unrealized PnL is not computed by the frozen engine (position-level only), so open fills render neutral with N/A totals until closed/marked at position level; rows are never coloured from BUY/SELL side.

Gross exposure is computed as sum|position.notional| because the canonical gross field in pre-remediation mark records is wrong (measured 0.0071 vs ~84k notional); the method is labelled in the UI and store.family_gross.

AppleEvent quit (Cmd-Q/Dock quit) terminates the process without the two cosmetic shutdown log lines (WKWebView close button produces them); either path releases the port and never touches the shadow workers.

The .app artifact itself is not committed (dist/ is gitignored by design); rebuild instructions with the exact pinned PyInstaller flags live in dashboard_app/README.md and Quant Shadow Dashboard.spec.
incidents: First build failed inside the frozen app with ModuleNotFoundError zoneinfo (engine is imported dynamically at runtime, so PyInstaller's static analysis missed its stdlib deps); fail-closed behaviour worked as designed (DATA ERROR + honest reason, no fake data). Rebuilt with --hidden-import zoneinfo + --collect-all tzdata (+ csv/hashlib/io/re/html/argparse/urllib.request) from the engine's measured import set; second launch LIVE.

First launch logged a false 'another instance running' note: the pidfile was written before the self-check read it. Fixed by checking first, writing second; rebuilt so the shipped bundle contains the fix.
Build-time deps pyinstaller 6.22.3 (+hooks-contrib) and tzdata 2026.3 were installed into the repo .venv; runtime deps were already present (pywebview 6.2.1, pyobjc/WebKit).
